ana rios: Quick sync 77 Labs wants a co-sell pilot using Dedicated in eu-central for their banking customers. Must have SAML, IP allowlist, and a spend cap. Can we confirm provisioning timeline and any blockers?
derek yang: We support SAML on Dedicated. Provisioning usually 72 hours after entitlements and approval. For eu-central we'll pull from the EU Dedicated pool; capacity check needed.
mike foster: Network: prefer VPC peering for lowest latency. Need their VPC CIDR and contact for peering setup. Also note: if they need PCI-level controls we'll need security review.
nana rios: They flagged KMS ownership and audit retention in the security questionnaire. @legal-ops can you review and prefill answers?
legal-ops: Will do. Short answers: Dedicated supports customer KMS integration during onboarding; default audit retention 90 days; extended retention needs addendum. I'll return the filled questionnaire by EOD.
eng-oncall-bot: notice: Dedicated tenant provisioning ETA ~72-96h depending on capacity and pending entitlements.
derek yang: Ops runbook outline: 1) Entitlement + provisioning 2) SAML metadata exchange 3) VPC peering test 4) Perf ramp to 400k tokens/day 5) Telemetry route + spend cap. I'll own provisioning + SAML.
mana rios: Thanks. Action items: Derek owns tenant & SAML; Mike drafts network template; Legal completes questionnaire. Schedule enablement call for Mon 14:00 UTC?
mike foster: Mon 14:00 UTC works. I'll bring batching suggestions to reduce token cost and sample SOW for partner-managed billing.
nana rios: Good 1. Keep thread for artifacts only. :white_check_mark:
